says: R5 and decision 0607 say no plan file links a superseded record and list only records, experiments, field rows and direction notes as history, but kalfa/records/src/Links.ts now skips every file under docs/plan/quests/, so a signed plan can link a superseded record and pnpm lint stays green.
proof: At head 4f98510db83b270295b79afbe95fcf599faddd8c, docs/guidelines/rules-and-records.md:95 reads 'No instruction file, plan file, pattern doc, glossary row or code comment links a superseded record', and kalfa/records/src/Links.ts:21 holds HISTORY = [..., "docs/plan/quests/"]. In a scratch clone with that entry removed, node kalfa/records/src/bin.ts check printed 'docs/plan/quests/full-run-cadence-PLAN.md:33  links 0539, which is superseded.' and exited 1; with the entry, the same repo prints nothing and exits 0. Only kalfa/records/README.md and the plan's correction note say plans in quests are skipped.
cost: A reader of R5 or 0607 believes every plan is checked; a new plan in docs/plan/quests/ that links a superseded record raises no finding, and the one live link to 0539 stays.
